achievements.title: 6th Rank out of 160 Teams — TetraTHON 2026
achievements.desc: Team 'Twin Tech Girls' secured 6th Rank at TetraTHON 2026 — a 36-hour Indo-French AI Innovation Sprint hosted at Navrachana University, Vadodara (NUV) in partnership with ISEN Méditerranée, France (July 31 - Aug 2, 2026). Co-created Arcanum AI, leading AI/ML and backend technical architecture.
